signal: Paystand acquired Bitwage in Nov 2025 and launched USDb, a bitcoin-aligned B2B stablecoin, building a full-stack CFO platform

email.body1:
Allison, saw Paystand acquired Bitwage and launched USDb, pushing the blockchain B2B payments network toward a full-stack CFO platform.

Expanding the platform that fast usually means more finance buyers in play than the team can cover before reps learn the new story, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Paystand off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Allison, quick follow-up for Paystand.

With new products layered onto the network, the addressable target usually grows faster than the team can cover. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Paystand needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Allison, last bit of proof for Paystand.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Paystand's reply rate likely compares to other fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Allison, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you integrate Bitwage and launch USDb, no problem at all. That much product motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a fintech motion? I will tailor it to Paystand either way.
